name: Deadly 60: Deadly Defenders
storyline: Steve Backshall is back on an epic quest to go deep into the jungle and come out with a photo of the rare Javan Rhino! But when his sleepy nights are threatened by the local intruders of leeches, rats and gibbons, it's up to the player to hire defenders to scare any intruders away before they get to Steve's tent and wake him up.
summary: Deadly Defenders is a tower defense strategy survival game in which you must protect a sleeping Steve Backshall from the many creatures, creepy-crawlies and other intruders that want to wake him up, and stop his pursuit of the elusive Javan Rhino! Tactically place defenders anywhere on the map so they can defend and scare away the intruders before they can reach Steve's tent. For every intruder defended, you'll earn skulls so you can get more and even better defenders. But be warned! With every wave, the intruders get stronger and faster, and Steve only has 10 lives before he officially has a bad night, so be vigilant.
